findings.body: Backup names now end in a random suffix, but retention still sorts filenames lexicographically. For two backups within the same second with --keep 1, a second suffix that sorts below the first causes _prune to delete the newly verified backup and retain the older snapshot. The command then reports status=ok with a zip path that no longer exists. The overwrite finding is resolved, but retention must order snapshots chronologically and protect the current backup. Add a regression test with a fixed timestamp, descending suffixes, and changed source content.
findings.title: Retention can immediately delete the newest same-second backup
